text: The major of Stomatology aims to cultivate high-quality applied specialized talents in stomatology who possess basic medical theories and clinical medical knowledge, master the fundamental theories and clinical operation skills of stomatology, can engage in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of common and frequently-occurring stomatological diseases in medical and health institutions, have a sense of social responsibility, innovative spirit, practical ability, and are well-rounded in morality, intelligence, physical fitness and aesthetics
